## Why

The H1 disposable future Delivery needs a small normal Change to exercise the complete Change lifecycle through the installed Flowkit distribution.

## What Changes

- Add one fixture capability contract.
- Complete one task during Apply.
- Keep all lifecycle authority in Flowkit/OpenSpec/Reviewer/Owner/Verification/Git.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `__CAPABILITY_ID__`: minimal future-Delivery self-hosting fixture capability.

### Modified Capabilities
- none.

## Impact

- Only the current OpenSpec Change task/verification artifacts are mutable during Apply.
